value.rationale: This optimizes a natural and unavoidable geometric trade-off when one boundary sampling distribution must serve both Euclidean area and perimeter. It gives a unique exact all-ellipse sampling law, an exact scalar characterization of unavoidable loss and a sharp near-circle 3/8 stability coefficient; qualitative incompatibility or a Hellinger distance does not supply these. It is a nontrivial complete family classification rather than an arbitrary small numerical improvement.
